description: Machine-readable registry of all Pathway design system components. AI agents building products read this to discover available components, their props, and their file locations.

sidenav.description: Persistent vertical navigation panel. Two levels of depth, expanded/collapsed states, responsive (push/overlay/hidden). Optional NavSectionLabel headings + optional SideNavListSection for contextual link lists.

items.description: Flat navigation tree — use this OR `sections`, not both. Each item: { id, label, icon?, children? }

sections.description: Sectioned navigation — renders NavSectionLabel headings between groups (or rail dividers in collapsed mode). Use this OR `items`.

listSection.description: Optional flat contextual list appended after the main nav (e.g. 'Recent Content'). Hidden in collapsed rail.

activeId.description: ID of the currently active navigation item

onNavigate.description: Called when user clicks a destination

scrollbar.description: System-wide overlay scrollbar. Hides the native OS scrollbar and renders one slim semitransparent thumb so scrolling is identical on macOS/Windows/iOS/Android and never takes layout space or shifts padding. Wrap any internal scroll region in <Scrollable>. First consumer: SideNav.

style.description: Wrapper style (positioning context). Use flex:1; minHeight:0 in a flex column.

viewStyle.description: Inner scroll-view style (content flex layout, gap, padding).

viewClassName.description: Extra class on the inner scroll view

checkbox.description: Multi-select selection control. Three states: unchecked, checked, indeterminate. Supports error, highlight, and secondary indeterminate variants. Two sizes. 44×44px touch target always.

indeterminate.description: Shows dash icon; overrides checked visually; sets aria-checked=mixed

error.description: Error / negative styling — fill and border switch to negative token family

highlight.description: Tinted background on the state-layer at rest — for selectable rows

secondary.description: Secondary indeterminate variant (muted colour) — use with indeterminate only

disabled.description: Non-interactive; still accessible to screen readers

size.description: Visual size of the control. Touch target is always 44×44px.

onChange.description: Called on user interaction with the new checked value

className.description: Additional CSS class on the root element

describedBy.description: aria-describedby pointing to an error message element (error state)

gaps: 8 tokens missing from token file — see spec §5.3. fill.action.secondary.* affects highlight variant resting state (HIGH priority).
Secondary Indeterminate use case TBD — confirm with design before shipping.
Highlight variant resting-state token (fill.action.secondary.rest) missing — fallback in use.

org-switcher.description: Organisation context switcher trigger in the brand-blue top nav. Renders the active org name (truncated with ellipsis at 180px desktop / 50px mobile). For Catholic organisations only, a second container after the org name shows the city or diocese. The trigger opens a drop panel listing accessible orgs.
org-switcher.v1Scope: Trigger only. Drop panel is a non-normative placeholder in v1 — see spec §0.

orgName.description: Full organisation name. Truncates with ellipsis at 180px desktop / 50px mobile.

orgType.description: Discriminant. Catholic orgs render a second container after the org name (CityName.Catholic). Protestant orgs render the org name on its own (no pipe, no second container).

cityName.description: City or diocese name. RENDERED ONLY when orgType === "catholic" (spec §0.1). Ignored for Protestant orgs even if supplied. NOT a campus/suborg/region name.

logoUrl.description: Org logo URL. Empty or omitted → church SVG placeholder (never text initials).

open.description: Controlled open state — flips the chevron icon 180°.

onClick.description: () => void — fired when the trigger is activated. Caller toggles the open state.

disabled.description: True for single-org users. Trigger renders inert at 50% opacity.

mobile.description: Force the mobile compact display regardless of viewport.

orgs.description: (Panel only — out of scope in v1.) Array of org records for the placeholder panel.

activeOrgId.description: (Panel only — out of scope in v1.) Highlights the active org in the panel.

onOrgSelect.description: (Panel only — out of scope in v1.) (orgId) => void when a panel row is clicked.

className.description: Additional CSS class on the root element.

accessibility.ariaLabel: Always includes the full org name (and city for Catholic orgs), regardless of visible truncation

gaps: Panel (dropdown / bottom sheet) not yet designed in Figma — trigger only ships.
ARIA pattern choice (Disclosure+listbox vs Combobox) deferred until panel is designed.
logoUrl placeholder tint (rgba(53,85,160,0.25)) is not a semantic token — TBD once brand-avatar token is added to Figma.
Panel mobile behaviour (dropdown vs bottom sheet) not yet decided.

top-nav.description: Fixed global navigation bar. Persists across all modules and viewports. Brand-blue surface, dark-mode tokens throughout. Three slots: ModuleSwitcher (left), OrgSwitcher (left), Search + ActionIcons + Profile (right). Spec status: PENDING HUMAN REVIEW.

activeModuleId.description: ID of the currently active module ('home'|'people'|'giving'|'events'|'comms')

moduleSwitcherType.description: ModuleSwitcher (app switcher) behavior. 'interactive' = chevron + hover/pressed, opens the app switcher. 'static' = Amplify Dashboard ONLY: current-module label with no chevron, no hover/pressed, not a control (nowhere to switch to from the dashboard). Maps to Figma 'Type' variant property. OrgSwitcher is unaffected.

activeOrgId.description: ID of the currently active organization

orgs.description: List of organizations the user can switch between

user.description: Current user profile for the avatar and menu

onModuleSelect.description: Called when user selects a module

onOrgSelect.description: Called when user selects an org

onSearchOpen.description: Called when search pill is clicked

onSideNavToggle.description: Called when hamburger is clicked (mobile only)

gaps: Active item token in dropdowns: uses raw #eef2fb — no semantic token exists yet (HIGH).
Notification badge / dot on bell icon not yet designed (HIGH).
Mobile profile tap behavior not specified (HIGH).
Destructive item (Sign out) uses raw red — no semantic danger token (MEDIUM).
TopNav position sticky vs fixed not resolved (MEDIUM).
Logo crop parameters tuned for Sacred Heart logo only (MEDIUM).

spinner.description: Indeterminate activity indicator. 8-spoke sunburst, arbitrary size, semantic-token-only colour via tone + emphasis.
spinner.moduleNote: React module added 2026-10-01 with NewCo's RING loader alongside Amplify's sunburst, as a `variant` prop. The ring's three arcs are currentColor at three stroke opacities rather than the concept's hardcoded purples, so it answers every tone and both brand themes. spinner.html remains the standalone demo for the sunburst. SpinnerKeyframes must be mounted once per document.

label.description: Accessible name announced by screen readers

button.description: Primary action trigger. Three styles (Fill / Outlined / Naked), four semantic types (Primary / Secondary / Tertiary / Negative), four sizes (L / M / S / XS). Supports leading icon, trailing icon, icon-only, and loading states. 48×48px touch target always.

buttonStyle.description: Visual style. Fill = solid surface (highest weight). Outlined = bordered transparent. Naked = no border or fill (lowest weight).

size.description: L = 18px label, M = 16px label, S = 14px label, XS = 12px label (8/6 padding, 16px icon wrap). Touch target is always 48×48px minimum. XS is defined in Figma for Primary/Secondary/Negative only (not Tertiary).

type.description: Semantic intent. Primary = brand blue. Secondary = neutral muted. Tertiary = lightest. Negative = destructive.

text.description: Visible label text. Also used as accessible name when showText is false.

leadingIcon.description: Material Symbols ligature name (e.g. 'add', 'check'). Rendered when showLeadingIcon is true.

trailingIcon.description: Material Symbols ligature name (e.g. 'arrow_forward'). Rendered when showTrailingIcon is true.

showText.description: When false: icon-only button. ariaLabel is required when showText is false.

loading.description: Replaces content with ButtonSpinner. Sets aria-busy='true'. Implicitly disables the button.

onClick.description: Click / keyboard activation handler. Not called when disabled or loading.

ariaLabel.description: Overrides accessible name. Required when showText is false (icon-only).

className.description: Additional CSS class on the outer <button> element.

accessibility.focusRing: 6px white halo + 2px brand ring via box-shadow on Container.Main

search.description: Pill-shaped search bar (SearchInput) and top-nav wrapper (TopNavSearch). v1 covers the bar and its states (idle, hover, focused, with-value, filter-active, disabled, error) plus TopNavSearch collapsed/expanded. The Open state (results dropdown) is deferred.

filterBadge.description: Shows dot badge on filter button

nav-shell.description: Application shell — TopNav + SideNav + content area. The outermost layout wrapping every Amplify page. Compose from top-nav.jsx and sidenav.jsx — do not reimplement.

module-icon.description: The twelve Amplify module marks. One geometry, two colour variants: Full resolves the module identity palette, Mono inherits currentColor.
module-icon.moduleNote: Identity colours are declared ON the component, not in the Variables panel: module identity is a brand axis rather than a semantic, and must not flip with the theme. Style=Rippled from the Figma set is not built yet.

title.note: Sets role=img and aria-label. Omit for a decorative mark beside a visible label.

skeleton.description: Loading placeholder. A block the shape of the content it replaces, with a 45 degree band sweeping bottom-left to top-right.
skeleton.moduleNote: Brought across from the NewCo and Spired design concept, token-pure. The concept hardcoded a rung of a `warm` primitive ramp that Pathway does not have, plus two literal rgba() stops; here the base is a semantic fill and the band is color-mix over tokens, so it inherits the brand theme and inverts in Midnight. SkeletonKeyframes must be mounted once per document: a module that injects CSS on import cannot be tree-shaken.
skeleton.specNote: No spec yet. Transcribed from the design concept rather than from a Figma component; there is no Figma node for it.
skeleton.figmaNote: No Figma component. The design lives in the NewCo and Spired concept, not in the Figma library.

circle.note: squares the box and fully rounds it, for avatars

lastLineWidth.note: short on purpose: equal-length bars read as a table, not prose

widget.description: The resizable dashboard building block. A header carrying the title, refresh and resize, plus a content slot. Size is depth: Glance, Explore, Detail, Full.
widget.moduleNote: Size is depth, not scale: resizing changes what the content shows. Flat at Glance (one surface, no content toolbar) and layered everywhere else, driven by the presence of content controls rather than by size directly. A KPI tile is not a separate component: it is Widget at Glance holding a Metric. Hover-revealed info and go-to icons are suppressed at Glance because their 36px targets hold layout even at opacity 0 and would eat most of a 130px title. WidgetKeyframes must be mounted once per document and also declares the --pw-widget-cols-* spans, so the breakpoint lives in a media query rather than a JS branch.
widget.specNote: The authoritative spec is widget-container-spec.md in the working folder, not in this repo. Its sections 3.1, 4 and 8.3 predate the token families that now exist (warm surfaces, radius, spacing, motion, elevation, touch targets) and describe them as raw values; the implementation binds all of them. Its section 5.1 names four sizes Small/Wide/Tall/Large, which section 0 supersedes with Glance/Explore/Detail/Full.
widget.demoNote: Shares the dashboard demo, because a widget on its own cannot show the grid, the manage mode or the resize flow.
widget.figmaNote: The component set carries three Size variants (Glance, Detail, Explore). Full is a separate Widget.Focus frame, not a variant. The NewCo section is a mirror and is read-only.

dashboard.description: The dashboard page template: the toolbar, the widget grid, and the templated flow for managing a dashboard and adding widgets.
dashboard.moduleNote: Owns the grid (4/8/12 columns by breakpoint, 48px row unit, dense row flow so widgets pull up and leftover space collects at the bottom) and the two modes. The save matrix is the part that is easy to get wrong: editing the System dashboard always names and creates a NEW custom dashboard, so the shipped baseline is never overwritten, while editing a custom dashboard saves back to it. There is no drag-to-pixel-position and no drag-to-resize; size is picked from the widget's own menu and compaction is always on.
dashboard.specNote: dashboard-shell-spec.md in the working folder, still marked DRAFT. Its four open questions are unresolved: the meaning of 'Reset to default' (implemented here as 'Discard changes', which is reading (a) only), whether a first save of an edited System dashboard should also offer to make it the default, what the real view-mode widget actions are besides Refresh, and what the unsaved-changes guard should do when switching dashboards (implemented here as: the switcher simply does not act while there are unsaved changes).
dashboard.figmaNote: The organism page is 'Dashboards'. The add-widget and manage flows live on the templated-flow page 'Dashboards: Add Widgets, Edit Dashboards', section 'Add Widget & Manage Flows v2'.

page-template.description: The screen template every Amplify page is built on: the top-navigation region, the page-navigation region, and a responsive sheet holding the page heading, tabs, toolbar and sections.
page-template.moduleNote: Owns the regions, the sheet and the four page-level compositions that only ever appear inside a page (PageHeading, PageTabs, PageToolbar, PageSection). It does NOT own what goes in the slots: TopNav and SideNav are passed in, and Card, Input, FilterChip, Heading, Button and the Tabs atoms are separate library components that do not exist in this repo yet. The sheet is the one responsive piece: its padding and corner radius resolve through Responsive: Layout by media query, so there is no JS branch for them.
page-template.specNote: No spec in this repo. The Figma component set is the source.
page-template.demoNote: No standalone demo: the Storybook stories compose it with the real TopNav, SideNav and Widget, which a self-contained CDN page cannot do without duplicating all three.
page-template.figmaNote: The component set is called ScreenTemplate, not Page Template; Page Template is the page it sits on. Its third breakpoint variant value is literally 'Breakpoint3', not 'Mobile', and the Code Connect enum has to match that verbatim or the prop comes back undefined for every mobile instance. Worth renaming in Figma.
page-template.tokenGap: The Figma component binds six contextual gaps that are NOT in the Pathway Variables panel: Contextual/Page/Gap/Horizontal and /Vertical, Contextual/Page Heading/Gap/Vertical, Contextual/Section/Gap/Horizontal and /Vertical, and Contextual/ToolBar/Gap/Vertical. They resolve through a published library rather than locally, so they are absent from the export and the repo has no name for them. Each resolves to a semantic gap that does exist (16 is Gap/Base, 8 is Gap/Tight) and the module binds those. Either add the six to the panel's Contextual collection, or accept the semantic bindings and drop them from the Figma component.
